name: Cord-class starfighter
description: Used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, the Cord-class starfighter was a starfighter model equipped with a single laser cannon. A Cord-class starfighter was stationed aboard the Republic Acclamator-class assault ship Candaserri when the assault ship was in orbit over Raxus Prime following the Battle of Raxus Prime in 22 BBY. After a battle, the starfighters were serviced by repair droids or the clone trooper pilots themselves.
